title: THE PAD CONTROLS PANEL NAMES NO KEYBOARD KEY
why: Seen on the 4K controller screenshot of 2026-10-08: on a controller (player 2 in co-op) the compact controls panel switches to pad buttons but still ended with H  full list, a keyboard key the pad player cannot press, since no pad button opens the full list. On a pad that line and its row are left out; with keyboard and mouse it is as before.
now: On a controller the controls panel lists only pad buttons.
